name: talkify
description: Real-time chat app: Express, Socket.IO and MongoDB backend with a React frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: eslint backend --max-warnings 0 && npm run lint --prefix frontend
